episodes.synopsis: Kaoru is dejected when her friends' busy lives prevent them from attending their annual Hanami. Rilakkuma can’t make pancakes without burning them.
episodes.title: Cherry Blossom

episodes.synopsis: A sense of panic takes over Kaoru when she receives a ransom note demanding a stack of pancakes in exchange for the safe return of Rilakkuma.
episodes.title: Kidnapped

episodes.synopsis: Heavy rains bring an unlikely growth of mushrooms inside the home, and Kaoru's spirits are dampened when she's the subject of office gossip.
episodes.title: Rainy Season

episodes.synopsis: While Rilakkuma is able to wholeheartedly enjoy the food and games at the summer festival, Kaoru grows frustrated by her own perpetual indecisiveness.
episodes.title: Fireworks

episodes.synopsis: During a sudden power outage, Kaoru and her friends are stopped dead in their tracks when a spirit from beyond the grave makes a surprise visit.
episodes.title: Ghost Girl

episodes.synopsis: After a streak of bad luck in the last days of summer, Kaoru sees a psychic, who implies that her three roommates are the cause of her problems.
episodes.title: Fortune-Telling

episodes.synopsis: To help her lose weight -- and to catch a glimpse of the cute deliveryman -- Kaoru keeps ordering more and more costly exercise equipment online.
episodes.title: Slim Down

episodes.synopsis: Seeing Kaoru struggle with her finances, Rilakkuma, Korilakkuma and Kiiroitori take it upon themselves to find part-time jobs -- with mixed results.
episodes.title: Getting a Job

episodes.synopsis: With a blanket of December snow covering the entire neighborhood, Rilakkuma offers his knit cap to a poor snowman who looks so cold.
episodes.title: Snowman

episodes.synopsis: The roommates bring the sounds of aloha into their home to brighten Kaoru's day when a colleague's engagement in Hawaii brings her down.
episodes.title: Hawaii

episodes.synopsis: Thinking a streak of light in the night sky was a UFO, Korilakkuma tries to call it back by building a pyramid-shaped beacon out of junk.
episodes.title: Sleepless Night

episodes.synopsis: In this flashback episode, Kaoru reminisces about the time she wanted a pet cat, but met the delightful bears who would become her roommates instead.
episodes.title: The First Day

episodes.synopsis: As their apartment's demolition date draws near, Kaoru searches for a new place, and they all do their best to toss out the things they don't need.
episodes.title: Moving Out
